verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a SaaS payroll platform with a public developer portal, so agent-oriented docs or an llms.txt are a fair question. However, the probe found llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and the evidence contains nothing about agent-oriented documentation; the REST API docs are ordinary human-oriented developer docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
